body:
Keel's first-wave STOP rollout freezes body heading even though its emitted STOP command still turns the body. KeelHelm changes only that rollout to use the existing orbit turn and engine-native Phys.step, so second-wave moving escapes start from the forecast heading. Power, guns, danger, search population and immutable Keel0.1.0 baseline stay fixed. Production AISurvivor is unchanged.

User direction and ownership: issue106. Prospective hypothesis, fixed populations and gates: issue107 / docs/improvements/keel-helm-v1.md. Facet/Prism remain separately owned; published rejected Prism evidence is retained by the conflict-resolved merge.

Candidate JAR SHA256:60ef5b1d33c3deb7100d1e66135f311d4b7b6fd5651cd1146effb899b9ea08c2. Java17:15semantic tests and788-entry parity passed; a separate reviewer independently rebuilt the exact same JAR bytes. Harness21pure integrity tests passed after approval revalidation, complete launch binding and owned-child teardown corrections. Failed fixtures and all review/build evidence are preserved.

Source freeze:benchmarks/keel-helm-v1/freeze.json, SHA256ef876a82069d5c73baf7171aa95cf4058e3bc4a196f46d51bdf5ff1cf0b81a9b,90assets. Exact published-head/CI clearance passed: https://github.com/stephanelee/robocode/pull/108#issuecomment-6636915907. No screen games have run and no improvement is claimed.

Registered screen:120rounds, fresh unchanged Keel controls versus Diamond Port and Retcon plus pinned Walls/AIS guards. Only all screen gates passing opens300fresh confirmation rounds. Maximum420physical rounds; no replacements. A separate active reviewer must approve finalized provenance from the same still-running worker before each fixed durable stage receipt/game. No automatic/profile roulette, no retry after partial acquisition.

Evidence:experiments/KeelHelm/validation/java17-local/, benchmarks/keel-helm-v1/{reviews,harness-validation,independent-analysis}/. Independent outcome reducer replays raw recordings without importing the harness reducer or candidate code.

Implementation does not merge its own PR. Required CI, exact source/artifact review, actual runtime approval and independent outcome review remain separate gates.

Actively assigned independent screen runtime reviewer: issue107 comment6636942994. No runtime approval is supplied by the source token; the same-worker artifact gate remains mandatory.

KEEL-HELM-SOURCE-CLEARED 368b49a9bae42a0cefd4fd9aa033a6bd576e566d
